svg.title: Arda Çabuk — embedded software and machine learning
svg.desc: An ASCII ripple tank. The name ARDA ÇABUK stands in the water as walls. A steady source between the two words sends out rings that reflect off the letters and bend through the gaps. Every ten seconds a second source fires at a different frequency; its rings are drawn in orange and the readout switches from nominal to anomaly.

g.text: 560 x 224 fdtd · hum 0.67 Hz · one period, looped
